The roof that follows the sun

Style

Read the colours

Orange petals lie flat and take the sun. Turquoise petals stand up and let the sky through. Everything between is a unit on its way.

Every aluminium fin on the facade, ground floor to roof, follows the same sun: where it shines straight onto a facade those fins swing shut along it, on the shaded sides they stand open at 90°.

How a unit works

Three framed petals hinge on the edges of one roof panel. One actuator at the centre lifts them like a flower opening, or lays them flat over the glass.

What decides the opening

Each unit compares its own tilt with the direction of the sun. The more squarely the sun strikes it, the further it closes. Near the top of the sky, every unit closes.
